definitions.gloss: asking and answering oneself; self-questioning; inner dialogue
definitions.explanation: The act of posing questions to oneself and attempting to find answers, often when facing a dilemma or reflecting deeply on something.

examples.japanese: {自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I questioned myself over and over.

examples.japanese: 「⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keep asking myself, 'Was this the right choice?'

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧べき⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧、⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{最終的|さいしゅうてき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辞|や}める⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After days of questioning myself about whether I should resign, I finally made the decision to quit.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): {自|じ} (self) + ⟦{問|もん}→〜問：04016_mon⟧ (question) + {自|じ} (self) + {答|とう} (answer). Used as a verbal noun with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Conveys introspection or wrestling with a difficult decision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to question oneself)
- {自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to repeatedly question oneself)
- {自問自答|じもんじとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ (after much self-questioning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自問|じもん}: self-questioning — just the questioning part, without the answering
- {内省|ないせい}: introspection, self-reflection — broader term for looking inward
- ⟦{葛藤|かっとう}→葛藤：05407_kattou⟧: inner conflict — focuses on the struggle rather than the questioning
